FloJos in Innsbruck

** Discover the cozy charm of **FloJos** in **Innsbruck**—a beloved spot for hearty Austrian dishes and a warm atmosphere. Tucked away in the heart of the city, this traditional **Tirol**-style tavern invites you to savor classics like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, and crispy **Käsespätzle**. Whether you're craving a hearty lunch or a relaxed dinner, **FloJos** offers a taste of authentic **Tirol** hospitality. Don’t miss their famous **Apfelstrudel** for dessert—pure comfort in every bite! Perfect for locals and visitors alike, this gem is a must-visit for anyone exploring **Innsbruck**’s culinary delights.
